d: Marilyn Monroe's timeless beauty inspires dazzling red carpet gowns. And a Hollywood legend pays a special visit to the workroom.
The All Stars finalists design collections representing all 4 seasons of the year. Zac Posen and Mira Sorvino join the judges and a VIP audience to crown the winner. Season finale.

Alyssa Milano reunites all 14 designers to debate the fashion, fights, and turmoil in Project Runway All Stars' biggest season ever. With exclusive behind-the-scenes moments and drama from inside the workroom. Alyssa also talks motherhood, social media, and her fellow judges. Highlights include: designers' Twitter tantrums, viewers' questions, and updates on the All Stars' careers and personal liv
13 All Stars return for the toughest season yet. Designers tap into their past to create a look inspired by a life moment that kick started their fashion career. Season premiere.
A wind machine runway challenges the All Stars to create dramatic, elegant looks that showcase the movement of fabric. Vanessa Hudgens guests.

st: A Little Bit Country, A Little Bit Rock n' Roll
d: Country music supergroup Little Big Town team up the designers to create "opposites attract" red carpet gowns for the Academy of Country Music Awards.
In the notorious Unconventional Materials Challenge, designers turn NYC emergency services materials into runway worthy looks. Johnny Wujek guest judges.
A totally naked runway introduces the designers to naturists who need winter wear to stay warm.
